name: Tourist / e-Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Citizens of Burundi, Kenya, Congo-Brazzaville, Rwanda, Tanzania, and Zimbabwe enter without prior visa authorization. Mauritian citizens can obtain a visa on arrival.

Most other nationalities apply through the official EVISA DGM platform (evisa.gouv.cd), described by third-party travel operators as strictly vetted with a high rejection rate; processing can take up to 3 weeks. Total cost around $540 ($450 upfront, $90 on arrival). Current rules reportedly bar independent applications without a confirmed tour booking. A 'flying visa' pre-approval or an airport/port visa (7+ days) are alternative entry routes; a standard tourist visa via a Congolese diplomatic mission abroad runs up to 6 months.
requirements.fix_path: Apply via evisa.gouv.cd or through a Congolese diplomatic mission, allowing several weeks for processing.

evidence_required.document: Confirmed tour booking (per current practice reported)

outcome.duration_length: 7 days to 6 months depending on visa type

sources.title: Kwafrika Travel (private tour-operator/visa-assistance site) -- current e-visa process via evisa.gouv.cd, fees, visa types, regional visa-free list, and the tour-booking requirement for independent applicants

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Democratic Republic of the Congo). STATUS: DRAFT -- the official evisa.gouv.cd government portal was fetched directly but returned only a JavaScript-disabled error page, no substantive content, so a tier-4 travel-operator source was used instead. GENUINE, SPECIFIC FINDING WORTH FLAGGING: multiple sources describe the e-visa system as having an unusually high rejection rate and a practical requirement to book through a tour operator rather than apply independently -- a real, sourced friction point distinct from most e-visa systems built in this dataset, though not confirmed as an official written rule (versus informal practice). Regional visa-free access mirrors similar patterns in other African countries built in this dataset (regional bloc/neighbor exemptions).
